steps.does: judge again, by the one certifier, every pinned candidate whose pinSet a repin changed; a failure marks its slot needs-refresh and goes to the slot's owner

render again every pinned Designer dependant the reverdict judged (clossys render, its index.json under clossys/.state/renders/), mark each pinned Publisher page that places one stale in clossys/.state/publish/stale.json, and re-run clossys publish --install --page for each stale page; a page whose install passes leaves the stale list

code accepts the cascade when the reverdict passed and cascade.clean holds now (every dependant's re-verdict passes): the impact step is settled and kept in a settle record; only a failure reaches the owner of the slot

DRAFT: the owner of the repinned slot reads what its repin changed and the re-verdicts of its dependants, and notes the impact in its own check scratch; it pins nothing and writes no other agent's tree

content.exit: every pinned candidate whose pinSet changed is judged on the pinSet now and certifies, its Designer dependants are rendered again and every page that places one is installed again; release can run
content.repeat: to a fixed point inside the step; past maxRounds a queue.clarify to the owner
